component.name: Linphone
component.summary: Open source softphone for voice and video over IP calling and instant messaging

description.p: Open source softphone for voice and video over IP calling and instant messaging. It is fully SIP-based, for all calling, presence and IM features.

screenshot.caption: Conversation and screen sharing to mobile

ul.li: DTMF can be sent with keyboard without opening the numeric pad during a call
"All/Missed" filter in call history
Call forwarding and voicemail settings links
Setting to host merged calls in a local conference
Setting to disable USB/HID headset controls
Accessibility:
* global key navigation improved
* add missing names for annoucement and apply naming conventions
* add missing open/close actions for popups and list menus
* force focus on first item when opening a menu
* audio volume sliders exposed as percent values
Improve emoji selector performance
End to end security not forced when creating a meeting if it is unavailable
Crash when opening the numeric pad for the second time during a call
Participant names in conference
Simplify the call window UI when calls are merged into a local conference
Translations update
SDK version is now 5.5.36
UI fixes (margins, layout, items visibility/overlap)
Fix blinking audio devices in multimedia settings during a call
Fix blinking video stickers when someone enters/leave an ongoing meeting
Use MSQOGL by default to avoid using native openGL library which misses some extensions
Translations update
SDK version is now 5.5.23
Use native emojis in the emoji selector (emojis display depends on the OS)
